methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Make in the browser. A Make account and access to the scenarios exposed to MCP.
methods.label: Sign in with Make
warnings: A Make account and access to the scenarios exposed to MCP.

methods.whenToUse: Use a Make MCP token when browser sign-in is not suitable.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a Make API token with the mcp:use scope and any additional scopes required by the selected scenarios. Enter the zone host from your Make organization. The token is sent as a Bearer header and remains a secret.
methods.label: Use an MCP token

tenantFields.label: Make zone host
tenantFields.helperMd: Enter the zone host for your Make organization exactly as shown in the Make MCP client setup instructions. The server URL is https://<zone>/mcp.

credentialFields.label: Make MCP token
credentialFields.helperMd: Provider-issued Make token. Include documented mcp:use and only additional scopes required by selected scenarios; exact scopes are user selected.

warnings: A token is a secret; do not place it in the server URL. Scenario availability depends on token scopes and scenario access controls.
